data.text: These are the people of the province who came up from captivity, from the exiles whom Nebuchadnezzor king of Babylon had deported to Babylon. They returned to Jerusalem and Judah, each to his own city.
They came with Zerubbabel, Jeshua, Nehemiah, Seraiah, Reelaiah, Mordecai, Bilshan, Mispar, Bigvai, Rehum, and Baanah. The number of the men of the people of Israel was:
The descendants of Pahath-moab, from the descendants of Jeshua and Joab: 2,812.
The descendants of Ater, of Hezekiah: 98.

data.titulo: The Towns of the Returning Exiles

data.text: The people of Kiriath-arim, Chephirah, and Beeroth: 743.
The people of Ramah and Geba: 621.
The men of Bethel and Ai: 223.
The people of the other Elam: 1,254.
The people of Lod, Hadid, and Ono: 725.
The priests: the descendants of Jedaiah, of the house of Jeshua, 973.
The Levites: the descendants of Jeshua and Kadmiel, from the descendants of Hodaviah, 74.
The singers: the descendants of Asaph, 128.
The descendants of the gatekeepers—the descendants of Shallum, Ater, Talmon, Akkub, Hatita, and Shobai—139 in all.
The temple servants: the descendants of Ziha, Hasupha, and Tabbaoth;
data.titulo: The Families of the Temple Servants

data.text: The descendants of Solomon's servants: the descendants of Sotai, Hassophereth, and Peruda;
of Shephatiah, Hattil, Pochereth-hazzebaim, and Ami.
All the temple servants and the descendants of Solomon's servants totaled 392.
These came up from Tel-melah, Tel-harsha, Cherub, Addan, and Immer, but they could not establish their ancestral house or their descent, whether they were of Israel:
the descendants of Delaiah, Tobiah, and Nekoda, 652.
Among the descendants of the priests were the descendants of Habaiah, Hakkoz, and Barzillai, who had married one of the daughters of Barzillai the Gileadite and was called by their name.
These searched for their entries in the genealogical records, but they were not found, so they were excluded from the priesthood as unclean.
The governor told them not to eat of the most holy things until a priest should arise with Urim and Thummim.

data.titulo: The Total of the Assembly and Its Resources

data.text: besides their 7,337 male and female slaves. They also had 200 male and female singers.
When they came to the house of the LORD in Jerusalem, some of the heads of the ancestral houses gave freewill offerings for the house of God, to restore it on its site.
According to their ability, they gave to the treasury for the work 61,000 gold coins, about 6,250 pounds of silver, and 100 priestly robes.
The priests, the Levites, some of the people, the singers, the gatekeepers, and the temple servants settled in their cities, and all Israel in their cities.
